runs.text: Snap: three photo tools in one tab
snap a treat's label to see if it's safe for your pet, with the sources.
see how your pet seems in a photo or a short clip. Just for fun.
cut your pet out of a photo and decorate a diary page.
Tap Request photo in Feed; your sitter's next photo answers it.
Checkout asks for your entry info when the sitter comes to your door.
Tap Start trip on drop-off and pick-up days. The other person sees the map and when you'll arrive.
Rather not share your location? The meeting place opens in Google Maps.
now sits next to Book on every sitter's profile.
Sitters pick the pet first when writing a daily note, and can add their own lines.

Chloe may use your lockbox code and condo buzzer only during the booked visits.
Your pet may share Chloe's home with up to 2 other calm, vaccinated pets.
Drop-off and pick-up happen at the agreed time and place.
If nobody is home at pick-up, your pet stays with the sitter until you confirm a new time.
Type your full name to sign
